name: ProjectCostKit
tagline: Free calculators and plain-English cost guides for home projects, built for homeowners and the pros they hire.
intro: Measure the room, get the number. Paint, flooring, concrete, fencing and more, with the math shown so you can check it.
description: Free home project calculators and cost guides: paint, flooring, tile, mulch, gravel, concrete, decks, drywall and pricing tools for contractors.
seoTitle: ProjectCostKit: Free Home Project Calculators and Cost Guides

author.name: ProjectCostKit
author.bio: ProjectCostKit builds free calculators and cost guides for home projects. Every formula is checked against manufacturer data or building code, and every price range links to its source.

hero.title: Know what your project needs before you buy a thing.
hero.text: Free calculators for paint, flooring, concrete, mulch, decks and more. Every formula is checked against manufacturer data, and every price range shows where it came from.
points: Works in feet or meters, dollars, pounds or euros
The math is explained under every calculator

toolsText: Each one remembers your last numbers, so you can come back to them.
startText: Good first reads if you are planning a project this season.

toolsPage.title: All calculators
toolsPage.text: Every calculator on the site, grouped by project. Each one works in feet or meters and remembers your last numbers.
toolsPage.description: Every free ProjectCostKit calculator in one place: paint, flooring, tile, grout, mulch, gravel, fencing, decks, concrete, drywall and contractor pricing.

promo.title: Run a painting, handyman or remodeling business?
promo.text: Price jobs with the same numbers you would use on site: estimates, hourly rates, markup and a printable quote. And if your business needs a website that brings in calls, we build those too, from $50.

disclaimer: Calculators and price ranges are for planning only. Materials, labor rates and codes vary by region, so confirm quantities with your supplier and get written quotes before you start.
